commit.subject: LU-10026 csdc: set DoM compression component
commit.message:
LU-10026 csdc: set DoM compression component

Allow to create file with compression DoM component.

EX-7806 csdc: not support data compression on MDT

Do not support setting data compression component on DoM until
data compression on MDT implemented.
